title: EDG Community Update: Week of October 3rd, 2022
body:
## **Highlights**

- One of the community validators, [kdpnetstake determined](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1578355962083155968)[a critical bug](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1578355962083155968) in the node client of the v4.0.0 pre-release on the testnet. Thus, we might need to wait for the next pre-release with the inclusion of the client fix which will be collectively tested on the Beresheet v4 testnet before proposing it on the mainnet.
- All the Validators, RPC infrastructure providers, Exchanges and Ecosystem Projects are requested to wait for the next pre-release (and not to upgrade to the [pre-release v4.0.0](https://github.com/edgeware-network/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v4.0.0) if you haven't done already).
- Upcoming Activities/Events: [Valorant Gaming Tournament](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/6514-edggaming-tournament)

## **Ecosystem Updates**

- Many Edgetributors (Edgeware contributors) attended the [crypto networking event 0xBreakfast](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1577697312373096449) in Mumbai and shared the word about the history of Edgeware, current ecosystem status and things in the pipeline.
- Get to know more technical-oriented updates on the '[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-oct-2/)'.
- Looking for the speculative performance of EDG? Check out the [Community-run DAO Financial Bulletins](https://blog.edgewa.re/tag/bi-weekly/).
- EDGizens are welcome to participate in [the research survey](https://forms.gle/XdjEyBEMY1EtZs3x9) by one of the ecosystem partners.
- Community Treasury-funded Web3 Media platform, [New-Futures opened up pre-registrations](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1469353591433478150?s=20) for their highly anticipated upcoming launch.
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink's oracle nodes on EdgeEVM, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
